notes.title: New Beta 6
notes.content:
Added improvements in the controls for the game with gamepad

- Dynamite Button
- Button keep flight and unlock flight

Little by little we will be adding improvements,
although the updates may take time to arrive,
because we are busy doing other projects.

Anyway we will continue listening to your suggestions

Thanks ːsteamhappyː
